limits: The original source includes fixed right hand grip and small stylized face/cloth seams; unchanged payload reuse does not claim those source limitations fixed.
Character clips preserve approved source quality; this new four-view layout awaits user acceptance.
Local source record paths identify retained authoring history, not runtime dependencies.
architectural_materials: Four original Shu authored SVG surfaces selected unchanged from retained tea-street materials; local new stage only. Material source retains original author/method/license/SHA256.

validation.result: Four real 1280x720 stage renders inspected; four validate() results empty; 12 projection round trips max error 0.0000611 logical pixels. Player/NPC real22-bone payloads loaded with original clips. Actual arrival UI route is root integration responsibility.
validation.detached_construction: All four actual Compatibility scenes constructed and initially synced before attachment, then attached and rendered: no warning/error. Local bone-chain calculation compared with live skeleton world transforms (max error below 0.000001m); sole contacts stay at y=0.004m.
validation.quest_props: Read-only set_city_flags controls river umbrella taken/returned state; actual render probe checked river hide and returned rack reveal/reset.
